artist_source.work_or_method: Later cut-outs and the use of line and colour
artist_source.basis: Published primary studio-method account checked 30 October 2026. It describes line as an expression of emotion, the joining of line and colour in cut-outs, painted paper, cut shapes and tested arrangements. All classroom descriptions are paraphrased. No quotation, artwork image, venue name or website address is supplied.
artist_source.interpretation: A pupil may say how a feature feels to them. No particular private mood or universal colour meaning is attributed to the artist.

planning_evidence: GROW keeps two small thumbnails or equivalent short action plans, a chosen idea and reason, materials and quantities, ordered making actions, practical time and space notes, access choices and a dated arts-log entry. Plans are not recorded as finished artwork.
